claim: Consequence includes involuntary order to active duty under 10 USC 12303
quote: Reserve Marines who fail to comply with the provisions of the agreement will be processed for unsatisfactory participation
fix: MCRAMM routes failure to Unsatisfactory Participation. Cite 12303 separately.

claim: Stop-loss authority under 10 USC 12305 lets the Secretary suspend separations
fix: Add the statute to the registry.

claim: $500 per month stop-loss special pay
fix: Cite the authority and note it is not a standing entitlement.

claim: Election due within 90 days of the Notice of Eligibility for Retirement at age 60
quote: decisions are made as soon as Marines are officially notified of retirement eligibility with 20 years of qualifying service
fix: The 90 day clock starts at the 20 year notification, not age 60. A married member who misses it is auto-enrolled with full spouse coverage.

claim: Option B survivor receives a reduced benefit if member dies before age 60
quote: Elect to provide an annuity to survivors, which becomes effective on the 60th anniversary of the Reserve Marine's birth if death occurs before that date.
fix: Option B pays 55 percent of full retired pay, starting on the member's 60th birthday date. The amount is not reduced.

claim: Annuity is 55 percent of the base amount
quote: The survivor annuity will be 55 percent of the member's full retired pay, or a lesser amount designated by the member

claim: Spouse must concur unless member elects the highest level
quote: Spouse concurrence must be witnessed by a notary.
fix: Add the notary requirement and the DD Form 2656-5 name.

claim: Premium is 6.5 percent of base, paid up at 360 months and age 70
fix: Cite the statute.

claim: Option A allows a later SBP election at age 60
quote: If the member attains age 60 and begins to draw retired pay, the member will automatically have the opportunity to enroll in the RCSBP.

claim: TFL is secondary payer to Medicare for retirees 65 and over
fix: Cite the statute or TRICARE source.

claim: Enroll in Medicare 3 months before 65
fix: Cite the SSA source.

claim: TRS requires being joined to an SMCR unit or IMA billet
quote: Only those SelRes Marines who are joined to an SMCR unit or IMA billet are eligible to enroll in TRS.

claim: Members eligible for FEHBP are ineligible for TRS
quote: Marines eligible to enroll in the Federal Employee Health Benefits Program (FEHBP)
fix: MCRAMM dates from 2015. Recheck against the current statute.

claim: TRS coverage starts 30 to 60 days after initial enrollment
quote: Qualified SelRes members may purchase TRS coverage to begin on the first day of any month of the year.
fix: Coverage starts the first day of a chosen month. Drop the 30 to 60 day range.

claim: TRS resembles TRICARE Select
quote: offering TRICARE Standard and Extra health coverage to qualified members of the SelRes
fix: Source predates TRICARE Select. Cite the current TRICARE manual.

claim: Coverage ends on activation over 30 days
quote: Marines serving on AD orders for more than 30 days are automatically eligible for TRICARE.

claim: TRR ends when pay begins at 60
fix: Cite the statute.

claim: FEHBP eligibility blocks TRR
fix: Verify against the current statute.

claim: TA pays up to $4500 per fiscal year
quote: not to exceed $250 per semester hour equivalent ... and $4,500 per individual per fiscal year

claim: Capped at $250 per semester hour and $166 per quarter hour
quote: $250 per semester hour equivalent, $166.67 per quarter hour ... $350 per semester hour equivalent for graduate courses
fix: Round to $166.67. Add the $350 graduate cap.

claim: Lifetime cap is 130 semester hours
quote: No lifetime credit hour cap appears in MCO 1560.25 or DoDI 1322.25 CH 4.
fix: Cite the source or remove.

claim: Passing grade is C undergraduate and B graduate
quote: a successful course completion is defined as a grade of C or higher for undergraduate courses, a B or higher for graduate courses

claim: Reservists qualify on active duty orders over 30 consecutive days
quote: active duty Marine Corps Reserve personnel (Active Reserve (AR), Extended Active Duty (EAD) and Mobilized Reserves) are eligible for Marine Corps TA
fix: MCO 1560.25 names AR, EAD and mobilized Reserves. No 30 day threshold appears.

claim: MGIB-SR needs a 6 year SELRES obligation
quote: upon agreement to serve at least six years in the SMCR

claim: TA and Post-9/11 GI Bill can run together
quote: RC members who have earned entitlement for the Post-9/11 G.I. Bill can use both VA education benefits and TA

claim: Travel to and from IDT falls under portal-to-portal UCMJ coverage
quote: A Reservist executing off-site IDTs pursuant to Government-funded orders shall be considered in an IDT status for purposes of UCMJ jurisdiction while traveling
fix: Limit travel coverage to off-site IDT under government funded orders.

claim: UCMJ requires the accused be subject at the offense and at trial
quote: The accused must have been subject to the UCMJ at the time of the commission of the offense.
fix: Add the involuntary AD route for offenses found after the period ends.

claim: IDT status starts on arrival at the duty location
quote: a Reserve Marine shall be considered in an IDT status beginning at the time of arrival at the designated IDT location

claim: IDT status ends when the member departs
quote: Such status shall continue until the member completes the final IDT period on the last day of such periods.
fix: End status at completion of the final IDT period.

claim: 9 or more unexcused IDT absences in 12 months
quote: accrues at least 9 unexcused absences from scheduled training within the preceding 12-month period

claim: Three outcomes: return to good standing, transfer to IRR, involuntary AD under 12303
quote: Retain the Marine and authorize EDPs ... Extend the SMCR Marine's MDPSD ... Initiate separation proceedings via CLA
fix: List retain with EDPs, MDPSD extension (missed drills divided by 4), and CLA separation. IRR transfer only at contract end or COMMARFORRES authority.

claim: Member gets a response period, typically 30 days
quote: A Marine determined to be an unsatisfactory participant will be sent a notification letter per Figure 4-6.
fix: Cite the Figure 4-6 response period.

claim: Count absences in a rolling 12 month window
quote: within the preceding 12-month period

claim: Formal letter follows MCRAMM Figure 4-6
quote: A Marine determined to be an unsatisfactory participant will be sent a notification letter per Figure 4-6.

claim: Pay Group B is SMCR with reduced participation
quote: Pay group "B" identifies IMAs, with remaining obligated service time who are required to attend up to 48 IDT periods
fix: Pay group B is IMAs. Remove the reduced participation text.

claim: IMAs are Pay Group F, not A
quote: Pay group "F" identifies SelRes personnel attending initial active duty for training (IADT).
fix: IMAs are group B. Group F is IADT. Rewrite the common error.

claim: Funeral Honors Duty has a 4 hour minimum
paragraph: Ch 3 Sec 2 para 2.a(5); Ch 4 Sec 1 para 2.a(1)(b)
quote: FHD ... shall be for a duration of not less than two hours.
fix: FHD minimum is 2 hours. Fix to match the IDT limits page.

claim: Paid EDPs within 60 days and the same fiscal year
quote: Paid EDPs must be performed within 60 calendar days after the missed IDT, and within the same FY as the missed IDT.

claim: MUTA-1 through MUTA-6 period and hour table
fix: MCTFSCODESMAN is not in the archive set for this cluster. Verify MUTA hours against it.

claim: Pay Group P earns 15 membership points per anniversary year
quote: MCRAMM holds a membership point table in Figure 4-3 and no pay group P definition.
fix: Cite MCTFSCODESMAN for group P.

claim: Six years of Selected Reserve service qualifies for the VA home loan
fix: Cite the statute or VA source.

claim: VA processing takes 30 to 60 days
fix: Drop the estimate or cite VA.
